lines.text: Anywhere but the 4th floor, dear!
The doors count us when they close. Three is lucky!
lines.textKo: 문 닫힐 때 몇 명인지 세는 거야. 셋이면 좋지!

lines.text: Three! Third time's the charm.
Aigoo! Four - 'sa' sounds like death!
Three of us! Lucky, lucky.
Four of us? 'Sa'... someone get off!
Three floors exactly - third time's the charm!
Four floors?! Even the ride says 'sa' - death!
lines.textKo: 네 층이나 탔어?! 타는 것까지 사(死)라니!

lines.text: Thank you, young one.
My knees, dear... is it coming?
I'll take the stairs. Slowly.
New numbers? My mother always said: hide the 4 and death can't find you.
lines.textKo: 숫자를 바꿨네? 우리 엄마가 그랬지, 4를 가리면 죽음도 못 찾아온다고.

lines.text: Quickly, quickly! Deals are waiting.
Room for eight? An excellent sign.
Eight for fortune, nine for long life!
Four?! 'Si' sounds like death! Bad for business!
lines.textKo: 4?! 쓰(四)는 죽을 사(死)요! 사업 망하오!

lines.text: Eight of us - full car, full wallet!
lines.textKo: 여덟 명! 꽉 찬 차, 꽉 찬 지갑!

lines.text: Four passengers? Terrible numbers!
Eight floors - 'fa', fortune all the way up!
lines.textKo: 여덟 층! 발(發), 오는 내내 돈복이오!

lines.text: Four floors? 'Si' - a deadly journey!
Good service. A lucky tip for you.
Time is money!
Too slow! I take my business elsewhere.
New numbers? A good number is good business.
lines.textKo: 번호를 바꿨소? 좋은 숫자가 곧 좋은 장사요.

lines.text: Hi! Is this the elevator?
Whoa, an elevator operator! So retro.
Seven! Lucky seven, baby!
Yikes. This floor gives me 13th-floor vibes.
Seven of us - jackpot!
Bit of a crowd, huh?
Seven floors on the dot - lucky seven ride!
lines.textKo: 딱 일곱 층! 럭키 세븐 드라이브!

lines.text: 13 floors?! Worst. Ride. Ever.
Awesome! Five stars!
Uh, hello? Anybody driving this thing?
Guess I'll get my steps in.
Ha! You can just... stick a new number on?
Together, please.
We always ride together - that's two of us.
lines.textKo: 저희는 늘 같이 타요. 두 명이에요.

lines.text: Seven! Like the Seven Lucky Gods!
Four is 'shi', nine is 'ku'... death and suffering!
Seven of us? What a blessing!
Four people? 'Shi'... let's not.
Seven floors together - the Seven Lucky Gods smile!
lines.textKo: 둘이서 일곱 층! 칠복신이 웃어 주네요!

lines.text: Four... no, nine floors? 'Shi', 'ku' - even the ride!
lines.textKo: 네 층... 아홉 층? 시(死), 쿠(苦)... 타는 것까지!

lines.text: Arigatou! A perfect honeymoon.
Darling, are we waiting forever?
Let's take the stairs... together.
That floor changed its number? How strange.
I only ride when it makes seven of us.
lines.textKo: 타는 순간 딱 일곱 명일 때만 탑니다.

lines.text: Seven. I can feel it.
Seven! Let it ride!
Bad omen. Doubling down anyway.
Lucky seven! Jackpot!
Wrong count. The dice hate me.
Seven floors. Lucky seven - the house pays out!
lines.textKo: 일곱 층. 럭키 세븐, 하우스가 돈을 낸다!

lines.text: House always wins? Not tonight.
Come on, seven... come on...
Cold streak. I'm out.
New number, new odds. I like it.
Numbers don't lie. Neither should floors.
lines.textKo: 숫자는 거짓말 안 해요. 층도 그래야죠.

lines.text: I'll be checking every floor number.
Six - 'liu liu da shun', all goes smoothly.
This floor does not add up.
Six aboard. The books balance.
That headcount is a rounding error.
Six floors, to the floor. 'Liu liu da shun.'
Correct floor, correct number. Thank you.
I am billing you for this wait.
Inefficient. Noted.
A sticker? That's cooking the books!
Bless you, child. Keep me far from the sixes.
Six, six, six is the number of the Beast. Mind every six.
lines.textKo: 육, 육, 육은 짐승의 수라네. 6이란 6은 다 조심하게.

lines.text: Seven - the day the Lord rested. Blessed!
Six! Six, six, six - the mark of the Beast!
Seven souls aboard. A holy number.
Six of us? Pray it never becomes six-six-six!
lines.textKo: 여섯 명이라니? 육육육이 되지 않게 기도하게!

lines.text: Seven floors - complete, like the seven days of creation.
lines.textKo: 일곱 층. 천지창조의 칠 일처럼 완전한 여정이로다.

lines.text: Six floors?! Six, six, six - the Beast rode with us!
lines.textKo: 여섯 층이라니?! 육육육, 짐승이 함께 탔구나!

lines.text: Go in peace, my child.
Patience is a virtue... mine is being tested.
I shall climb toward heaven by the stairs.
Painting over a number does not cast out the devil.
Ciao! Anything but 17, eh?
In Italy 13 is lucky - 'fare tredici' means hitting the jackpot!
lines.textKo: 이탈리아에선 13이 행운이야. '13을 맞힌다'는 건 대박이란 뜻이지!

lines.text: 13! Fare tredici - jackpot!
17? XVII is VIXI - 'I have lived'. Mamma mia!
13 floors! Fare tredici - I win!
lines.textKo: 열세 층이나 탔어! 13을 맞혔다, 내가 이겼어!

lines.text: 17 floors?! XVII... VIXI, 'I have lived'. I'm finished!
lines.textKo: 열일곱 층이라니?! XVII... VIXI, '나는 살았었다'. 난 끝났어!

lines.text: Grazie mille! Bellissimo.
Ma dai! At my age I have no time to wait!
lines.textKo: 에이 참! 내 나이엔 기다릴 시간이 없다고!

lines.text: Basta! The stairs, like in my village.
A new number? Back home we simply skip the seventeen.
lines.textKo: 번호를 바꿨어? 우리 동네에선 그냥 17을 건너뛰지.

lines.text: ...Fourth floor. The one you hide.
Don't mind me. I've waited a long time.
Four... out in the open. Too easy.
lines.textKo: 4... 이렇게 다 드러나 있으면, 너무 쉽죠.

lines.text: Not this one.
Four of us now. How fitting.
Four floors. You are learning.
...No. Not this one. The real fourth floor is the hidden one.
You hid the four to keep death out. But hidden floors are where we live. Thank you.
lines.textKo: 죽음을 막으려고 4를 가렸죠. 그런데 가려진 층이 바로 우리가 사는 곳이에요. 고마워요.

lines.text: I can wait. I always have.
...Another night, then.
You can cover a number. It's still there.
